title: Prosecution points to ‘lavish spending’ by VP Duterte’s spouse

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution believes the “lavish spending” on the part of lawyer Manases Carpio, Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, is contrary to the constitutional requirement for public officials and their spouses to live modest lives. During the cross-examination of the defense panel’s witness, Chadrin Parian, prosecution counsel Reynaldo Robles questioned the P256,000 worth of sneakers Carpio bought during a trip to Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. In his testimony, Parian said his son was among the 11 boys who were selected to represent the country for a basketball tournament in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
